originality.rationale: Targeted mathematical-record queries on sampling-without-replacement reversal, positive definite quadratics, and exact one-epoch comparisons found no mathematical implication covering the derived two-parameter polynomial phase law. Das et al. 2022, Koloskova et al. 2024 and Liu 2026 address sampling methods with rate bounds rather than this pointwise exact family. The sharp reversal follows from a new four-path enumeration; uncertainty about the full inaccessible 2026 manuscript and unindexed exact examples remains.
residual_risks: Unindexed published or unpublished finite-horizon comparisons may derive equivalent two-component examples.
The 2026 PMLR article full text was not accessible via the attempted open-access route; its abstract is insufficient for a whole-paper exclusion.
The result does not establish later-epoch, optimized-step or higher-dimensional general behavior.

value.rationale: A motivated boundary case for the widely used with/without-replacement comparison, under two genuine strongly convex interpolating components at step 1/L. The fully characterized two-parameter open reversal region, sharp b=3/4 transition at p=1/2 and nearly factor-two first-epoch expected objective separation distinguish instancewise loss from favorable asymptotic rate guarantees. No general superiority or full convergence theorem is claimed.
